scope: Dry-development six-axis controller; exact Prime products and inventory reconciliation live in sourcing/.

items.purchase_requirement: Headered Raspberry Pi Pico RP2040, soldered 2×20 headers, Micro-USB data cable; selected module B0D4V1S1SK
items.purpose: USB host controller; Pico H/WH or standard RP2040 Pico with soldered headers use the same firmware target.

items.purchase_requirement: BIGTREETECH TMC2209 V1.3 removable modules, heatsinks, two R110 current-sense resistors per module
items.purpose: Six-pack B08WZFK9KT is study anchor; exact received module schematic/pin labels must agree with manifest.

items.purchase_requirement: Home-built covered isolated-pad protoboard/socket terminal backplane: twelve eight-position female sockets, matching received BTT module spacing, insulated jumpers and labeled screw terminals; VM electrolytics listed separately.
items.purpose: Six removable drivers with separately accessible VIO, VM, ENN, STEP, DIR, MS1, MS2 and PDN_UART. Follow the BTT P1A net map; commercial A4988 carriers without exposed UART/address nets do not implement this backplane.

items.purchase_requirement: 40-pin Pico screw-terminal breakout, all GP0..22,GP26..28,3V3 and GND accessible
items.purpose: Avoid Dupont connections for moving/stop wiring.

items.purchase_requirement: Regulated24V-to-5V DC buck converter, input ≥30V rated, output≥0.5A, fixed5V preferred; enclosed or covered terminals
items.purpose: Keeps Pico/VIO/ENN powered after host USB unplug; fed before motor cutoff relay, through500mA input branch fuse.

items.purchase_requirement: 1N5819 Schottky diode≥1A,≥40V
items.purpose: External5V→diode→PicoVSYS; band towardVSYS, blocks backfeeding the external supply when USB also powers Pico.

items.purchase_requirement: Regulated enclosed 24V DC supply, ≥5A, correct mating output connector; no exposed mains terminals
items.purpose: Dedicated supply for six drivers, motor cutoff relay, logic buck and fan; independent of the existing rotator supply.

items.purchase_requirement: Latching twist-release mushroom stop, two independent normally-closed contact blocks, ≥24V DC 0.2A control rating
items.purpose: NC1 interrupts only relay coil; NC2 carries3.3V logic loop.

items.purchase_requirement: 24V DC coil relay with normally-open power contact rated ≥24V DC 6A resistive, socket/terminal cover
items.purpose: Requires manufacturer DC contact rating, not an AC-only rating; coil current ≤0.2A.

items.purchase_requirement: Maintained MOTOR POWER toggle, DC24V0.2A or better
items.purpose: In series with NC1 and relay coil; OFF for wiring/USB flash.

items.purchase_requirement: SPDT lever microswitches with COM and NC contacts accessible, positive mounting holes
items.purpose: Two travel ends and two opposing force-link overload switches per axis; four NC contacts in series on each existing input. Metal capture bounds the link independently.

items.purchase_requirement: Four separate SPDT mechanical switches, positive mounting and verified DC24V0.2A-or-better coil-control rating; COM/NC/NO accessible
items.purpose: Two independent gun-release channels, each axial COM–NC plus seated-plate COM–NO in series; one channel interrupts relay coil, the other opens STOP sense. Both closed when healthy. Total axis/crash microswitch count28.

items.purchase_requirement: One 5A main + six 1A motor branches + one 500mA logic-buck input + one 500mA relay-coil branch + one 500mA fan branch; DC-rated inline fuse holders and spare fuses, ≥32V DC
items.purpose: Ratings are starting protection choices. Selected fuse/buck/VM-capacitor combination must pass the cold-start and MOTOR POWER cycle acceptance; no inrush margin is assumed from catalog ratings.

items.purchase_requirement: Six100uF≥35V + one470uF≥35V electrolytics; polarity visible
items.purpose: Local VM bypass if carriers lack it; main bus bypass near carrier group.

items.purchase_requirement: 10kΩ × 9, 1.8kΩ × 2, 330Ω × 2, 100kΩ × 1, 1% quarter-watt axial assortment
items.purpose: Seven NC input pull-ups, ENN pull-up and VM-divider lower leg use 10k; two UART bus pull-ups use 1.8k; two TX series resistors use 330Ω; divider upper leg uses 100k. TX is released during driver replies.

items.purchase_requirement: 100nF ceramic capacitor≥25V
items.purpose: GP27 supply-sense divider filtering.

items.purchase_requirement: 1N4007 or equivalent diode rated≥1A,≥50V
items.purpose: Across24V relay coil, banded cathode at coil+; omit only if socket has verified equivalent diode/polarity.

items.purchase_requirement: 18AWG stranded red/black motor distribution;22AWG paired switch/signal wire; ferrules, labeled terminal blocks, strain-relief glands
items.purpose: Common0V motor/logic at distributionstar; switches twist signal withGND; no motor wire through Pico terminals.

items.purchase_requirement: Seven GX16-4 four-pole locking plug/socket pairs, ≥2A/contact: six motor pairs and one crash CH1 pair
items.purpose: Motor pins1/2=A1/A2,3/4=B1/B2. Crash CH1 uses only pins1/2 in the24V coil chain;3/4 unused. Different family from GX12-2 sense connectors prevents24V/GPIO cross-mating. Map actual numbered contact views; mate only with24Voff.

items.purchase_requirement: Eight GX12-2 locking plug/socket pairs: six axis NC loops, STOP sense and crash CH2
items.purpose: Loop pin1=input-side, pin2=GND return; crash CH2 contains axial COM–NC and seated plate COM–NO. Crash CH1 uses a GX16-4 pair instead. Label every connector at both ends.

items.purchase_requirement: 24V DC fan, 80mm frame, ≤0.2A, two finger guards and fixed mount; wired through its own 500mA fuse from switched VM
items.purpose: Cross-flow across all six heatsinks during enabled hold and loaded development; verify the 50°C surface/temperature-trend gates with this fan installed.

items.purchase_requirement: 36 M3×25 bolts +36 M3 locking nuts +72 M3 flat washers;4 M4×50 bolts +4 M4 locking nuts +8 M4 flat washers;4 M6×16 bolts +4 slot8 M6 T-nuts +4 M6 flat washers. Include this additional allocation when merging mechanism/camera packs.
items.purpose: 24 carrier,4 Pico-adapter,2 DIN-rail,4 fuse-block and2 fan-stand M3 points;4 fan M4 points;4 fixed-backplane M6 points. Ready printed backplane/28 insulating spacers/fan stand and exact fitting manifest are in mounting/. Uses owned SunTop unfilled PETG reservoir-candidate stock.

loaded-development.scope: Nominal digital configuration and explicit tolerance assumption only; actual coil current, loaded motion and thermal behavior unqualified.
